acceptance: Cargo workspace configured with Rust Edition 2024 and workspace lints (forbid unsafe_code, clippy::all deny).
Crate aipo-source implemented: Source, SourceMap, SourceSpan with byte offsets, line/column translation, UTF-8 validation, BOM handling, LF/CRLF normalization.
Crate aipo-diagnostics implemented: Diagnostic, DiagnosticCode stable catalog, Severity, Label, and JSONL emitter.
Baseline test suite passes with cargo test --workspace.
Quality gates pass: cargo fmt --all -- --check, cargo check --workspace, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings, cargo doc --workspace --no-deps.
constraints: Result-based error handling: no panics carrying Aipo user errors.

evidence.description: Cargo workspace tests pass with 8 green tests and clean quality gates

non_goals: Lexer or parser implementation (scheduled for S2/S3).
VM or runtime implementation (scheduled for S6/S7).
objective: Establish Cargo workspace with Edition 2024, strict lints, aipo-source, aipo-diagnostics, and quality gates
title: Foundation: Workspace, diagnostics and source abstraction
